subject.title: feat(talk): use Codex OAuth for browser realtime voice

question: Should OpenClaw adopt the proposed public realtime browser-session broker API and the experimental talk.realtime.providers.openai.authMode="codex-oauth" operator contract for bundled Codex OAuth voice?
rationale: The implementation is intentionally additive, but the choice determines the permanent plugin-SDK seam, supported setup path, and compatibility expectations for future provider-owned browser authentication modes.

options.title: Sponsor the experimental broker contract
options.body: Accept the Codex-plugin-owned broker and explicit configuration mode after inspectable live proof confirms the bounded browser flow and cleanup behavior.

options.title: Keep browser Talk Platform-key only
options.body: Pause or close this direction and retain the current documented Platform API-key browser route until maintainers want a broader provider-authentication API.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the experimental broker contract
recommendation.body: Accept the Codex-plugin-owned broker and explicit configuration mode after inspectable live proof confirms the bounded browser flow and cleanup behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history covers both the former Codex-auth fallback and the current public-Realtime authentication boundary.
